label: TSA rail cybersecurity incident reporting
statusNote: In force through the SD 1580-21-01 and 1582-21-01 series (the 01C versions ran to 2025-10-24). A 2026 OMB notice cites an SD 1580-26-02 series. Uncertain: check the current version.

triggers.label: New information about the incident
triggers.hint: Supplemental information is due within 24 hours of it becoming available.

clocks.label: Cybersecurity incident report
clocks.rule: Report the cybersecurity incident to CISA within 24 hours of identifying it.

clocks.label: Supplemental information
clocks.rule: Send supplemental information within 24 hours of it becoming available.

appliesTo.note: Freight and passenger railroads and rail transit systems the directives name.
